result.summary: The page is generally polished and visually consistent. No critical issues are apparent, though a few carousel and overlay behaviors may feel visually incomplete or obstructive.

issues.description: The category chip row is cut off on the right, leaving a partially visible next chip without an obvious scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle fade, scrollbar, or other cue indicating the row is horizontally scrollable, while preserving the peek of the next item if intentional.

issues.description: The third 'Fastest near you' restaurant card is visibly clipped at the right edge, making its name and image incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Confirm this is an intentional horizontal carousel and provide a clear scroll cue; otherwise constrain the cards to fit the viewport.

issues.description: A loading spinner is displayed prominently over the Tokumaru Ramen Bar image, which may look like a stuck or incomplete card if it persists.
issues.suggestion: Remove the spinner once content loads, or use a less prominent loading placeholder/skeleton until the card is ready.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlaps the lower restaurant card image at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding so scrolling can reveal the full card above the navigation bar.
